steps.title: Prepare embryo medium
steps.instruction: Dissolve 2.94 g NaCl, 0.13 g KCl, 0.49 g CaCl₂·2H₂O, 0.81 g MgSO₄·7H₂O, and 10 g methylene blue in 10 L reverse‑osmosis water; this yields final concentrations of 5.03 mM NaCl, 0.17 mM KCl, 0.33 mM CaCl₂, 0.33 mM MgSO₄, and 0.1 % (w/v) methylene blue.

steps.title: Prepare agarose solutions
steps.instruction: Make two 1 % agarose solutions in embryo medium: (a) low‑melting‑point (LMP) agarose (Invitrogen 15517‑014) and keep at 50 °C; (b) regular agarose (VWR 0710‑500G) for coating dishes.

steps.title: Prepare 4‑OHT stock solution
steps.instruction: Reconstitute (Z)-4‑hydroxytamoxifen (Sigma H7904) to 10 mM in 1 % DMSO, aliquot as single‑use portions, and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Set up breeding and collect embryos
steps.instruction: Place homozygous Tg(sox17:Cre ERT2); Tg(ubi:Zebrabow) adults in breeding tanks with dividers; remove dividers to allow spawning and synchronize development; collect embryos and culture in embryo medium at 28.5 °C until the dome stage (~4 h post‑fertilization, hpf).

steps.title: Dechorionate embryos and coat dishes
steps.instruction: Using fine Dumont tweezers (style 5), gently remove chorions in a petri dish coated with 1 % agarose (coat by pipetting hot 1 % agarose to cover the bottom, then allow to solidify). Transfer dechorionated embryos with a fire‑polished glass transfer pipet to a 12‑well flat‑bottom plate whose wells are pre‑coated with 1 % agarose.

steps.title: Treat embryos with 4‑OHT
steps.instruction: Replace embryo medium in each well with fresh medium containing 5 µM 4‑OHT (diluted from the 10 mM stock) and 0.1 % DMSO; for control wells add 0.1 % DMSO only. Add 5–6 dechorionated embryos per well and incubate at 28.5 °C from the dome stage (4 hpf) to the shield stage (6 hpf).

steps.title: Wash embryos to remove 4‑OHT
steps.instruction: At the shield stage, gently swirl embryos and replace the medium with fresh embryo medium lacking 4‑OHT; repeat this wash three times to fully remove the drug.

steps.title: Develop embryos to imaging stage
steps.instruction: Return washed embryos to 28.5 °C incubator and allow development to the desired stage (e.g., any epiboly stage for DFC behavior or 1–2 somite stages for KV morphogenesis).

steps.title: Immobilize embryos in low‑melting agarose
steps.instruction: Using a glass‑bottom MatTek dish, transfer a single embryo with a glass transfer pipet, remove most of the surrounding medium, and cover the embryo with liquid 1 % LMP agarose (maintained at 50 °C). While the agarose solidifies, orient the embryo under a stereomicroscope so that DFC/KV cells face the glass bottom. Once solidified, add embryo medium to cover the agarose and prevent drying.

steps.title: Mount multiple embryos for screening
steps.instruction: Repeat the immobilization procedure to mount five or more embryos in the same dish, enabling screening for appropriate mosaic labeling before detailed imaging.

steps.title: Configure confocal microscope for live imaging
steps.instruction: Place the MatTek dish on an inverted spinning‑disc confocal (Perkin‑Elmer UltraVIEW Vox) equipped with a 20× objective and an environmental chamber set to 32 °C. Set laser parameters: 488 nm laser at 30‑50 % power with 500‑800 ms exposure; 561 nm laser at 30 % power with 100‑300 ms exposure. Minimize laser power and exposure to reduce phototoxicity.

steps.title: Acquire Z‑stacks and time‑lapse images
steps.instruction: Select an embryo with bright YFP mosaic labeling. Capture a Z‑series through the entire KV using 2 µm Z‑steps: ~35 steps (≈70 µm) at the 2‑somite stage and ~45 steps (≈90 µm) at the 8‑somite stage. For time‑lapse, acquire full Z‑stacks every 5 min; imaging up to 3 h (e.g., from 2 ss to 8 ss) has been shown not to cause photodamage.

steps.title: Convert raw data to OME‑TIFF
steps.instruction: In Volocity, right‑click the acquired image and export it as an OME‑TIFF (.ome) file for compatibility with Imaris.

steps.title: Import OME‑TIFF into Imaris
steps.instruction: Open Imaris (v8.4.0), click the Assay icon to create a new project, then the Group icon to add a group. Use the Image icon to import the OME‑TIFF file. Open Image Properties (Ctrl‑I) to assign channel colors. In the Geometry tab, set voxel size: X = 0.33 µm, Y = 0.33 µm, Z = 2 µm (the Z‑step used during acquisition). Adjust signal levels in the Adjustment window (Ctrl‑D) and click Store.

steps.title: Render single cell in 3D
steps.instruction: In the 3D view menu, click Surface. Enable “Segment only a region of interest”, then click the blue Next button to display the ROI bounding box. Switch to Select mode (ESC) and resize the box to enclose a single cell. Choose the YFP (green) channel as the source signal. Set Surface Detail = 1 (smooth) and Threshold = 15 µm (appropriate for KV cells). Click Next, adjust the rendering slider, and use Navigate mode to inspect the 3D model. Optionally, enable “Split Touching Objects”, set Seed Point Diameter = 8, and click Next until the detected cell count matches expectations. Finish to generate the 3D surface of the selected cell.

steps.title: Edit rendering and extract measurements
steps.instruction: Select the rendered surface, click the Edit (pencil) icon, and duplicate the surface to isolate the cell of interest. Open Statistics (graph icon), go to the Detailed tab, and choose measurements such as area, volume, and intensity. Use the Clipping Plane (scissors) to slice through the cell for cross‑sectional analysis. Capture snapshots with the Snapshot tool, then copy and save the file via the File menu.
